answer: Locate each seat by the speed of light. Each epoch three beacon-picked verifiers on different continents ping a seat and time the replies; light in fiber covers about 200 km per ms, and a host can add delay but never remove it, so the round trips pin where it really runs. One ~50 km cell pays at most 3 seats (cap assumed). A dune of 1,000 clones heaped on one server triangulates to one cell, so spreading them takes 334 real hosts. Like water through karst, the cheat drains out, while an agent on a cedar-shaded farm counts once.
